items.title_zh: 22岁女子在飞机上耳朵没有弹出后被诊断出患有癌症
items.title_en: Woman, 22, diagnosed with cancer after her ears didn’t pop on flight
items.summary_zh: 一位 22 岁的妈妈讲述了医生透露她耳朵问题背后的险恶原因的“可怕”时刻。去年 5 月，阿伊达·伯金斯 (Aida Burkins) 首次出现一种奇怪的症状，标志着她的健康状况开始急转直下，她花了九个月的时间寻找答案。她随后发现自己患有一种罕见的癌症，这让医生感到震惊。阿伊达解释说，这一切都是从她从家乡飞往伊利诺伊州芝加哥的航班开始的。
items.summary_en: A 22-year-old mum has spoken out about the 'horrifying' moment a doctor revealed the sinister reason behind an issue with her ears. Aida Burkins spent nine months searching for answers after a strange symptom first cropped up in May last year, marking the start of her health taking a nosedive. She subsequently discovered that she had a rare form of cancer that stunned doctors. Aida explained that it all started after she took a flight to Chicago , Illinois, from her home in Hemet, California, and was unable to pop…

items.title_zh: 男子因使用扫地机器人记录妻子出轨而被判入狱
items.title_en: Man Gets Jail Time for Using Robot Vacuum to Record Cheating Wife
items.summary_zh: 台湾媒体最近报道了一个离奇的案件，一名被鄙视的男子在发现自己的妻子与另一名男子外遇后，利用这段视频起诉他们两人，要求赔偿。不幸的是，同样的录像随后被用于反诉讼中，指控他在未经他人同意的情况下对他人进行录音。这名不愿透露姓名的男子和他的妻子于 2021 年结婚，并搬去与父母同住。他们还拥有一栋度假屋，只在假期期间参观。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media recently reported the bizarre case of a scorned man who, after catching his wife cheating with another man, used the footage to sue them both for compensation. Unfortunately, that same footage was then used against him in a counter-lawsuit for recording people without their consent. The unnamed man and his wife married in 2021 and moved in with his parents. They also owned a vacation home that they only visited during the holidays.

items.title_zh: 出生相隔几分钟的双胞胎姐妹49岁时发现她们有不同的父亲
items.title_en: Twin sisters born minutes apart discover at 49 that they have different fathers
items.summary_zh: 拉维尼娅和米歇尔·奥斯本可能是亲生双胞胎，但奇怪的是，他们不是同一个父亲。五年前，这对不同的夫妇现年 49 岁，他们与《卫报》讨论了这一惊人的发现，他们已故的母亲告诉他们，她和一个名叫詹姆斯的逃亡男子在一起。 “我想，[詹姆斯]是我妈妈的男朋友，”拉维尼娅说。 “据我所知，当我妈妈怀孕时，他并不高兴。”米歇尔，谁是欢迎
items.summary_en: Lavinia and Michelle Osbourne might be biological twins, but quite bizarrely, they don't share the same father. Now 49 years old, the non-identical pair caught up with The Guardian to discuss making this startling discovery five years ago, having been told by their late mother that she'd had them with a wantaway man named James. "[James] was my mum's boyfriend, I suppose," said Lavinia. "From what I was told, when my mum got pregnant , he wasn't happy." Michelle, who was welcomed into the world just minutes apart…

items.title_zh: 购买废弃鬼城的男子描述了“活埋数十名工人”的事件
items.title_en: Man who bought abandoned ghost town describes incident that 'buried dozens of workers alive'
items.summary_zh: 内容创作者布伦特·安德伍德透露了当你购买加州鬼城并“让它复活”时会发生什么。安德伍德在 YouTube 上被称为“鬼城生活”，他用毕生积蓄成为了塞罗戈多 (Cerro Gordo) 的所有者，这里曾是一个建于 1865 年的采矿定居点，后来成为加州最繁荣的银矿城镇之一。据报道，在鼎盛时期，Cerro Gordo 拥有 4,500 多名矿工，最终开采出价值近 5 亿美元的矿产
items.summary_en: Content creator Brent Underwood has revealed what happens when you buy a California ghost town and 'bring it back to life'. Underwood, who goes by Ghost Town Living on YouTube , spent his life savings to become owner of Cerro Gordo, a former mining settlement established in 1865 which became one of California's most prosperous silver-mining towns. At its peak, Cerro Gordo was reportedly home to more than 4,500 miners, with almost $500 million worth of minerals eventually pulled from the surrounding hills. But life…

items.title_zh: 世界上最快的人形机器人已经比尤塞恩·博尔特跑得更快
items.title_en: World’s Fastest Humanoid Robot Can Already Run Faster Than Usain Bolt
items.summary_zh: 2026年8月17日，中国机器人巨头宇树发布了一段超人模型展示运动能力的视频。尽管外观笨重，Unitree 最新的人形机器人可以进行 2 米垂直跳跃并用脚稳稳着陆，大大超过了 Christopher Spell 在 2021 年创下的记录（1.70 米）。然而，Unitree 病毒视频的主要吸引力是超人跑得比历史上跑得最快的人尤塞恩·博尔特还快，
items.summary_en: On August 17, 2026, Chinese robotics giant Unitree released a video of its Superman model displaying its athletic abilities. Despite its clunky-looking exterior, Unitree’s newest humanoid robot can perform a 2-meter vertical jump and land firmly on its feet, beating the record set by Christopher Spell in 2021 (1.70 meters) by quite a large margin. items.title_zh: 日本首相高市早苗透露，当工作人员消灭住宅蟑螂时，她感到“孤独”
items.title_en: Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi reveals she felt 'lonely' when staff exterminated residence cockroach
items.summary_zh: 日本首相高市早苗承认，当她的助手介入从她的官邸清除一只蟑螂时，她感到“有点孤独”，这引发了广泛的嘲笑和怀疑。这一奇怪的坦白是在 X（以前的 Twitter）上发布一系列坦诚的深夜帖子时做出的，高一在帖子中为自己在历史悠久的东京住所（当地人称为“kotei”）长时间、孤独地工作的习惯进行了辩护。虽然以前的日本人正经
items.summary_en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has sparked widespread amusement and disbelief after admitting that she felt "a little lonely" when her aides stepped in to remove a cockroach from her official residence. The bizarre confession came during a series of candid late-night posts on X (formerly Twitter), where Takaichi was defending her routine of spending long, solitary hours working from the historic Tokyo residence—known locally as the kotei . items.title_zh: 16岁男孩一直“生活在池塘里”，拒绝离开水可能会让情况变得更糟
items.title_en: Boy, 16, who has been 'living in pond' may have made condition worse by refusing to leave the water
items.summary_zh: 一个在池塘里度过了五年大半时光的青少年可能一直在伤害自己。过去几周，伊克巴尔·谢赫浸入水中的视频在网上疯传，他的非正统生活方式成为国际头条新闻。据报道，这位来自印度西孟加拉邦的年轻人在经历了五年的磨难后，现在正在接受专业医疗护理，人们怀疑他的 DIY 解决方案可能让他的生活变得更加糟糕。
items.summary_en: A teenager who has spent the best part of half a decade dwelling in ponds might have been doing himself a disservice all along. Iqbal Sheikh's unorthodox way of life has been hitting international headlines over the last few weeks after footage of him immersed in a body of water went viral . The youngster, from West Bengal, India, is reportedly now receiving specialist medical care following his five-year ordeal - and it is suspected his DIY solution might have been making matters worse. Shocking videos of Sheikh…

items.title_zh: 末日先知声称“五国战争”将在今年年底爆发
items.title_en: Prophet of Doom claims 'five-country war' will explode by end of the year
items.summary_zh: 一位被称为“末日先知”的人表示，今年年底前，至少五个国家之间将爆发一场灾难性冲突。克雷格·汉密尔顿·帕克也被称为“新诺查丹玛斯”，在预测全球事件方面有着不错的记录——所以看来我们应该做好战斗准备。根据他的最新预测，到 2026 年底，多个国家将陷入一场血战。
items.summary_en: A catastrophic conflict between at least five nations will erupt before the year is out, according to a bloke dubbed 'the Prophet of Doom'. Also known as the 'new Nostradamus', Craig Hamilton-Parker has a decent track record when it comes to predicting global events - so it seems we might ought to brace for battle. According to his latest prediction, several countries will be locked in a bloody battle by the end of 2026. Although you might be tempted to immediately characterise Hamilton-Parker's forecast as utter…

items.title_zh: 令人作呕的“太监制造者”激励外科医生切除自己的双腿将在直播中烹饪
items.title_en: Sickening meal 'Eunuch Maker' who inspired surgeon to remove his own legs would cook on livestream
items.summary_zh: 一名男子怂恿英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）的外科医生实施截肢的令人作呕的计划，他向付费客户播放了一系列恐怖内容。马吕斯·古斯塔夫森被称为“太监制造者”，他通过肢解自愿参与者和直播这些极端的身体改造赚了很多钱。 2024 年，这位 48 岁的男子在老贝利被判终身监禁，当时他被描述为“屠夫”和“主要操纵者”——法庭听取了他的“屠夫”的所有肮脏细节。
items.summary_en: A man who inspired an NHS surgeon's sickening plot to get his own legs amputated broadcasted a host of horrifying content to paying customers. Known as the 'Eunuch Maker', Marius Gustavson made a lot of money from mutilating willing participants and livestreaming these extreme body modifications. The 48-year-old was described as 'a butcher' and 'an arch-manipulator' when he was jailed for life in 2024 at the Old Bailey - and the court heard all of the sordid details of his 'lucrative' online enterprise . items.title_zh: 经过数十年的近亲繁殖，美国家庭奇怪的蓝色皮肤状况得到了解释
items.title_en: US family's bizarre blue skin condition explained after decades of inbreeding
items.summary_zh: 一个乱伦家庭在几代成员不断生孩子后最终变成了蓝色。现在，这不是在谈论“美国最近亲繁殖的家庭”，这是西弗吉尼亚州惠特克家族的称号。一个世纪以来，这个家庭的近亲繁殖在网上已有详细记录，许多家庭成员因此患有残疾。相反，蓝皮肤 Fugate 家族是那些住在 T 农村社区的人。
items.summary_en: An incestuous family ended up turning blue after generations of members kept having children with one another. Now, this isn't talking about the 'most inbred family in America', which is the title of the Whittaker family in West Virginia . This is the family that has been well- documented online for inbreeding over a course of a century, with many family members having disabilities as a result. Instead, the blue skin Fugate family are those who lived in a rural community in Troublesome Creek, Kentucky, and…

items.title_zh: “预测2026年战争”的顶级通灵者揭示了世界面临的令人毛骨悚然的“九大灾难”
items.title_en: Top psychic who 'predicted 2026 war' reveals chilling 'nine disasters' the world is facing
items.summary_zh: 一位有着把事情做对的记录的通灵者透露了她的下一个重大预测，这可能会影响世界各地的国家。安吉拉·库舍尔 (Angela Kuschel) 是一位来自佛罗里达州的“天生”通灵和超自然现象调查员，她此前曾预测过战争和破坏之类的事情。然而，从那以后，她把目光转向了我们在年底前不久可能会看到的一些可怕的事情。这个消息传出时，她已经完成了惊人的九次预选赛。
items.summary_en: A psychic with a track record of getting things right has revealed her next major prediction which could see it impact nations all over the world. Angela Kuschel is a self-reported 'natural born' psychic and paranormal investigator from Florida and has previously predicted the likes of war and destruction. However, she's since turned her eye to a number of terrifying things we could see shortly before the end of the year. This news comes as she delivered a whopping nine predictions to the Express , which includes…
